rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for giving one thing a particular shape or form.

example.english: We shape this piece of wood into a tabletop.
example.traditional: 我哋將呢塊木板整成一塊枱面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 ni1 faai3 muk6 baan2 zing2 sing4 jat1 faai3 toi4 min6

rows.note: Use this when shaping soft material such as clay or dough by pinching or kneading it with your hands.

example.english: I shape the clay into a little dog.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 nai4 nip6 sing4 jat1 zek3 siu2 gau2

rows.note: Use 形狀 as the all-purpose noun for an object's visible outline or geometric form.

example.english: The shape of this graphic is unusual.
example.traditional: 呢個圖形嘅形狀好特別。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 tou4 jing4 ge3 jing4 zong6 hou2 dak6 bit6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a person's or animal's physical health and fitness.

example.english: My shape has been pretty good lately; I can even run faster.
example.traditional: 我最近身體狀況唔錯，跑步都快咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 san1 tai2 zong6 fong3 m4 co3 paau2 bou6 dou1 faai3 zo2

rows.note: Use this for the general condition or state of an object or situation, rather than specifically its shape or health.

example.english: The old computer is really in bad shape.
example.traditional: 部舊電腦嘅狀況真係好差。
example.jyutping: bou6 gau6 din6 nou5 ge3 zong6 fong3 zan1 hai6 hou2 caa1
